lines.zh: : 可你{i}会的{/i}。

lines.en: : If you didn’t have any other options, you would.
lines.zh: : 如果你别无选择，你就会。

lines.en: : Like, can you even imagine how cute our babies would be? They’d be the cutest things in the whole wide world. I’d love them until they pop.
lines.zh: : 就说，你能想象我们的宝宝会有多可爱吗？他们一定是全世界最可爱的东西。我会爱他们爱到他们爆掉为止。

lines.en: : Ami...
lines.zh: : Ami……

lines.en: : You’ll change your mind eventually. I know you will. You’ll {i}have{/i} to. It’s the only way this can work.
lines.zh: : 你早晚会改变主意的。我知道你会。你{i}必须{/i}会。这是唯一行得通的方式。

lines.en: : Listen...I’ll spend more time with you. I’ll...show you how much you mean to me more often. And besides, it’s not like I’m expecting to just “go back to normal” overnight.
lines.zh: : 听着……我会多花时间陪你。我会……更经常地让你知道你对我有多重要。再说了，我也不指望自己能一夜之间就「恢复正常」。

lines.en: : This is going to be a process and I’m going to need your help.
lines.zh: : 这会是个过程，而我需要你的帮助。

lines.en: : I can’t help you out there.
lines.zh: : 在外面我帮不了你。

lines.en: : It’s {i}scary{/i} out there. That’s why I keep you {i}here.{/i}
lines.zh: : 外面{i}很可怕{/i}。所以我才把你留在{i}这里{/i}。

lines.en: : You can’t trust people, Sensei. They always want something out of you. Every single one of them has ulterior motives and they just...
lines.zh: : 你不能相信别人，Sensei。他们总是想从你身上得到什么。他们每一个都别有用心，而且他们只是……

lines.en: : You can’t trust them. But you can trust {i}me.{/i} I’m the one who’s always been here. {i}Me.{/i}
lines.zh: : 你没法相信他们。但你可以相信{i}我{/i}。一直在这里的人是我。{i}是我{/i}。

lines.en: : Which means you’ll be with me no matter {i}where{/i} I go, doesn’t it?
lines.zh: : 也就是说，不管我去{i}哪里{/i}，你都会陪着我，不是吗？

lines.en: : I don’t know anymore...
lines.zh: : 我不知道了……

lines.en: : You’re planning on leaving me then?
lines.zh: : 那你是在打算离开我了？

lines.en: : I think you’ve got it backwards. I won’t {i}be able{/i} to follow you if you keep trying to break my kneecaps. And that’s exactly what you’re doing right now.
lines.zh: : 我想你搞反了。如果你一直想敲碎我的膝盖骨，我就{i}没法{/i}跟着你了。而你现在做的正是这件事。

lines.en: : One week, Ami.
lines.zh: : 一个星期，Ami。

lines.en: : I’ll stay here with you until winter break is over. I won’t talk to anyone but you and I’ll spend all of my time {i}with you.{/i}
lines.zh: : 我会在这里陪你，直到寒假结束。除了你我谁也不见，我所有的时间都会{i}和你{/i}在一起。

lines.en: : Unless you break again. Right? If you break again, you’ll stay forever?
lines.zh: : 除非你又坏掉。对吧？如果你又坏掉了，你就会永远留下来？

lines.en: : Or until I wake back up.
lines.zh: : 或者直到我重新醒来。

lines.en: : But luckily for you, I’ve grown rather accustomed to dreaming as of late. So, who knows? Maybe I’ll feel safer asleep and wind up staying in bed a little longer than anticipated after all.
lines.zh: : 不过对你来说幸运的是，我最近已经相当习惯做梦了。所以，谁知道呢？也许我会在睡梦里觉得更安全，最后在床上躺得比预想的更久一点。

lines.en: : I won’t accept this...I won’t support you putting yourself in harm’s way for {i}any{/i} reason. Let alone one as ridiculous as...whatever it was you said before.
lines.zh: : 我不会接受这种事……我不会支持你以{i}任何{/i}理由把自己置于险境。更别提是像……你之前说的那个什么一样荒唐的理由。

lines.en: : You don’t have to accept it, Ami.
lines.zh: : 你不必接受，Ami。

lines.en: scene black
: You just have to be there.
lines.zh: : 你只需要陪在我身边。

lines.en: scene bedroom_night
Later that night, I pledge to isolate myself from everyone and everything but Ami until school starts again.
lines.zh: 那天晚上，我立誓在开学之前，把自己与除 Ami 以外的所有人和所有事隔绝开来。

lines.en: This means nothing for most as, to them, I’ve already been gone for two months.
lines.zh: 对大多数人来说这没什么区别，因为在她们眼里，我已经消失了两个月。

lines.en: But I know the girl who was here earlier will be dying inside for the next week as she wonders what happened after she left.
lines.zh: 但我知道，先前在这里的那个女孩，接下来的一周会在心里备受煎熬，想着她离开之后发生了什么。

lines.en: I’m sure she’ll return tomorrow. And I’m sure she’ll have a million questions about why I’m confined to my room once more.
lines.zh: 我确信她明天就会回来。我也确信她会有一百万个问题，问我为什么又一次被关在房间里。

lines.en: Maybe Ami will answer her, maybe she won’t.
lines.zh: 也许 Ami 会回答她，也许不会。

lines.en: I have no way of knowing without being told and, at least from my point of view, she seems completely opposed to mentioning {i}anyone{/i} but her unless she absolutely has to.
lines.zh: 没人告诉我，我就无从得知；而至少在我看来，除非万不得已，她似乎完全不愿意提起{i}除她以外{/i}的任何人。

lines.en: But...do you know what the saddest part of all of this is?
lines.zh: 可是……你知道这一切里最悲哀的部分是什么吗？

lines.en: I don’t {i}want{/i} to leave.
lines.zh: 我{i}并不想{/i}离开。

lines.en: I don’t {i}want{/i} to risk getting hurt again.
lines.zh: 我{i}并不想{/i}冒再一次受伤的风险。

lines.en: I want to stay here, where I know it’s safe.
lines.zh: 我想留在这里，留在这个我明知安全的地方。

lines.en: Where I have someone who loves me — someone I love back.
lines.zh: 这里有爱我的人——也有我爱的人。

lines.en: scene black
But I can’t.
lines.zh: 但我不能。

lines.en: Because sometimes, forcing people to do things they’re not comfortable with is the best way to move them forward.
lines.zh: 因为有时候，逼人去做他们不舒服的事，反而是推动他们前行的最好方式。

lines.en: There’s a pair of scissors on the desk that whispers this to me in a voice I’d rather forget.
lines.zh: 桌上有一把剪刀，用一个我宁愿忘掉的声音，对我低语着这句话。

lines.en: I go to sleep with my tail tucked between my legs.
lines.zh: 我夹着尾巴入睡。

lines.en: And I count down the days until those scissors help me cut my teeth at coping.
lines.zh: 我一天天数着日子，等那把剪刀帮我磨出应对之道的牙齿。
